findings.quote: It may be riding the edge of the circle its chain allows, not dragging its sinker.
findings.note: PARTIALLY / WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C (~70%). General marine knowledge of a moored buoy's watch circle points straight at C, and C is also the only qualified option ('may be') beside three assertive ones ('must be', 'for most of the year', 'will lift it'). The hedge asymmetry is a probabilistic test-wise tell rather than a determinative one and the distractors are substantive positions, so this routes to adjudication instead of a lethal verdict.

findings.quote: What keeping a floating light on station involves, and an unsettled argument about slack.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick B (~75%). Standard main-idea umbrella tell: B names both the process and a controversy while A, C and D each name one narrow thread (a lightship crew, logger advocacy, maintenance cost). Scope comparison alone answers it without the passage. Normal main-idea design, so flag rather than kill.

findings.quote: Tuning can cost more than the bronze on a small bell, and less than it on a heavy one.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D (~70%). Tuning labour is roughly fixed per bell while metal cost scales with mass, so the cross-over D describes is the economically expected answer; A is D's absolute-form contradiction ('always takes a larger share'). The remaining distractors are substantive claims a passage would have to settle.

findings.quote: The bell has to leave the mould heavier, since the metal tuning removes must be there first.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick A (~80%). Bell tuning only ever removes metal, so a founder intending to tune all five partials tightly must cast heavy — ordinary founding knowledge decides this blind. D also falls to 'always'. Still a genuine comprehension question a passage would ground, hence flag not kill.

findings.quote: How a bell's partials are tuned, what that work costs, and how far founders take it.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick D (~85%). Main-idea umbrella tell: D semantically contains the other three, which are narrow (price driver), obscure (bronze recovery) or evaluative (deserve more care). Answerable by scope comparison with no passage.

findings.quote: Bats use it in most summers, although it sits in the same position as the laundry's row.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick C (~70%). A and C form an absolute/qualified minimal pair ('occupied every single summer' vs 'use it in most summers') and the qualified member wins on the usual test-wise heuristic, while B and D are unanchored calendar detail. The tell is probabilistic, not determinative, so flag.

findings.quote: One end of a void was far warmer than the other, and the animals moved between the two.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D (~75%). A thermal gradient that lets a colony shift between warm and cool ends is the standard roost-ecology fact and the standard explanation for why replacement boxes fail; A additionally falls to 'the whole of a void'. Distractors are substantive, so adjudication rather than kill.

findings.quote: Why some purpose-built replacement roosts are taken up by bats while others stand empty.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick B (~85%). Main-idea umbrella tell: B covers the whole trial while A, C and D each name a peripheral thread (planning conditions, one officer's method, an inter-officer dispute).

findings.quote: Luft tränger in, veden brinner upp i stället för att förkolna, och kolningen går förlorad.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick B (~88%). The defining fact about a charcoal kiln is that air ingress turns pyrolysis into combustion; anyone who knows what kolning is answers without reading a word. A is physically backwards (air makes the mila hotter, not slower to cool) and D falls to 'ofelbart'. Comprehension value is thin here — strong flag, close to the recall boundary, but the mechanism is domain knowledge rather than form, so not a kill.

findings.quote: Kolet smulades sönder vid omlastning och måste fram kort väg, medan tjäran tålde långa transporter.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D (~85%). Standard economic-history fact: charcoal is friable and bulky so it had to be produced near the hytta, while tar travelled in barrels; A is the straight inversion of that. A passage would ground it, but a domain reader needs none.

findings.quote: Att gränsen kan visa var brukets egen skog tog slut, inte hur långt vinterns slädar kom.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick A (~68%). A has the canonical shape of a scholarly objection (an alternative explanation for the same boundary), C falls to 'aldrig', and D is a units nitpick that does not bear on the boundary claim. Not decided blind — B remains a live reading — so adjudication.

findings.quote: Låntagaren fick säd och lämnade tillbaka lika mycket vid skörden, jämte ett tillägg på vanligen en åttondel.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C (~75%). How a Swedish sockenmagasin worked — grain lent in spring, repaid in kind after harvest with a customary one-eighth surcharge — is general agrarian-history knowledge, and A is eliminated because repayment in money defeats the granary's purpose. Institutional recall does much of the work, though the item is still a legitimate detail question.

findings.quote: Kyrkvärden förvarade båda nycklarna och kunde därför öppna magasinet utan att någon annan var närvarande.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, near-structural; blind pick A (~82%). B, C and D all describe the ABSENCE of a safeguard (one keyholder acting alone, bookkeeping deferred to year end, one man answering alone for the accounts) — precisely what a magasinsordning exists to prevent — so they cluster and A stands apart as the only ordinary regulation. The asymmetry is close to visible from form alone; held at flag under the calibration bar, but adjudication should consider escalating.

findings.quote: Att den vilar på sparbankerna fastän bokens egen förteckning visar nedläggningar långt före häradets första sparbank.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind pick D (~65%). C is D's overstated twin ('ingen enda av socknarna') and falls to its own absoluteness, leaving D as the internally-evidenced critique a reviewer actually makes. A and B stay live, so the item is not decided blind.

findings.quote: De visar att husen ofta överlevde inrättningen och fick nya uppgifter.
findings.note: STRUCTURAL_LEAK (stem entailment), blind pick B. The stem — 'Vilken funktion har uppgifterna om vad magasinsbyggnaderna senare användes till?' — presupposes that the text reports later uses of the buildings, and that presupposition already entails option B: if there are later uses, the houses outlived the institution and got new tasks. B therefore adds nothing the stem has not already given, while A, C and D each attach a further causal claim (fire service hastened the wind-up, upkeep grew costly, hembygdsföreningar saved the buildings) that the stem does not license. No passage and no domain knowledge are needed: the only option that merely restates the stem wins.

findings.quote: De hade ett givet mått i fyrkant, medan tjockleken blev den som vinterns kyla råkade ge.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C (~85%). Lake ice can be sawn to a chosen square plan but its thickness is whatever the winter froze — plain physical logic, and A is the exact inversion of it while B is self-undermining ('vägde alltid omkring hundrafemtio kilo, oavsett'). A reader who thinks about how ice was harvested does not need the passage.

findings.quote: It builds up where the chain drags on the bottom and close to the swivel.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick B. Marine domain knowledge says mooring-chain wear concentrates in the touchdown zone and at the swivel, and that mechanical abrasion outweighs salt corrosion, which weakens C; A's universal per-link figure and D's channel-width rationale also read as informed-solver rejects. A, C and D are still substantive claims a passage could ground, so flag rather than kill.

findings.quote: It may be riding the edge of the circle its chain allows, not dragging its sinker.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C, with a modal asymmetry alongside it: A says 'must be', D says 'will' and B generalises to 'most of the year', while C alone is hedged, and watch-circle swing is standard buoy knowledge. The distractors are real operational claims (A is even true in itself), so the form tell is not decisive on its own - flag, not kill.

findings.quote: Tuning can cost more than the bronze on a small bell, and less than it on a heavy one.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D. Tuning labour scales with the number of partials rather than with mass while metal cost scales with mass, so an informed solver predicts the two-sided claim and discounts A ('always takes a larger share') and C (lathe time rising with weight) on the same reasoning. Distractors remain substantive positions, so flag.

findings.quote: The bell has to leave the mould heavier, since the metal tuning removes must be there first.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick A. Bell tuning is subtractive lathe work, so anyone who knows the craft infers the casting must carry surplus metal; B is additionally false in the world as stated ('Every partial in the bell is lowered by thinning'), and D carries 'always'. This is inference from domain knowledge rather than recall and the distractors are substantive, so flag.

findings.quote: One end of a void was far warmer than the other, and the animals moved between the two.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D. Thermal gradient within a roost and animals shifting between warm and cool ends is the standard finding in bat-roost literature and the premise the rest of the sheet needs; A ('The whole of a void stayed close to thirty degrees') reads as its purpose-built foil. B is substantively plausible and the item is genuine comprehension work, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Luft tränger in, veden brinner upp i stället för att förkolna, och kolningen går förlorad.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE shading into general recall, blind pick B: air ingress turning pyrolysis into combustion is the defining fact about a charcoal kiln and is decidable with no text at all. D is an absolute foil ('ofelbart ... oavsett'). A and C stay plausible enough that the key is not left alone in the plausible set, so flag rather than a RECALL_ONLY kill - but this is the weakest passage-dependence in the unit.

findings.quote: Kolet smulades sönder vid omlastning och måste fram kort väg, medan tjäran tålde långa transporter.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick D: charcoal friability versus barrelled tar is the textbook reason and needs no passage. Aggravating factor for adjudication: the stem sheet itself supplies the fact, since q:1 option C states 'Kolet blir ofta sprött och smulas sönder redan vid den första omlastningen på brukets slädar', so a solver working the sheet in order can corroborate D without reading the text.

findings.quote: Låntagaren fick säd och lämnade tillbaka lika mycket vid skörden, jämte ett tillägg på vanligen en åttondel.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C: lending in kind and repayment in kind with a supplement is the standard account of the Swedish sockenmagasin, and A (repayment in money) contradicts the institution's purpose while D describes a mechanism that would not spread any risk. B stays substantive, so flag.

findings.quote: Den som inte betalat tillbaka vid Mikaeli fick stå över utlåningen följande vår.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick A: B, C and D each describe governance an ordinance of this kind exists to forbid (a single key-holder, no entry in the books until year-end, sole responsibility for the accounts), so a reader who knows the two-key convention discards all three and A stands alone. The asymmetry needs domain knowledge to see rather than form alone, so flag rather than a structural kill.

findings.quote: Att han överdriver sparbankernas roll så till den grad att ingen enda av socknarna i boken stöder sambandet.
findings.note: PARTIALLY: C and D are near-twins on the savings-bank point, with C absolutised ('ingen enda') and D the measured, evidence-citing version of the same criticism. That pairing is visible from form alone and pushes a blind solver towards D. A and B survive as distinct criticisms, so the tell narrows the field without deciding it - flag.

findings.quote: De visar att husen ofta överlevde inrättningen och fick nya uppgifter.
findings.note: STRUCTURAL_LEAK, blind pick B - stem leakage. The prompt already grants that the text carries 'uppgifter om vad magasinsbyggnaderna senare användes till', and that premise entails exactly what B asserts: the buildings outlived the institution and were put to new uses. B is the stem restated in general terms. A, C and D each require an additional fact the stem does not supply (the fire service taking over, maintenance costs, heritage associations saving the buildings), so the item is decidable with no passage and no domain knowledge.

findings.quote: De hade ett givet mått i fyrkant, medan tjockleken blev den som vinterns kyla råkade ge.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, blind pick C: lake-ice thickness is set by the winter, so harvested blocks are cut to a standard plan measure with the thickness left to the season. A is the physical inverse of that and B is close to self-refuting ('vägde alltid omkring hundrafemtio kilo, oavsett hur kall vintern hade varit'). D remains a substantive detail a passage could carry, so flag.
